versions.canon_status: Non-canonical in Jewish, Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant canons; canonical in the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church; quoted in Jude 14-15.

compilations.title: The Words of Jesus
compilations.method: Derived from the source translation's own quotation marks and the narrator's attribution clauses; stores offsets, not text. Passages the narrator does not attribute are omitted; a short hand-listed set is marked "curated". The Father's voice is labeled separately, never folded in.
